title: Add cargo-deny to CI for license and advisory auditing
description:
Add cargo-deny to CI: runs `cargo deny check` covering licenses (deny GPL), advisories (deny unmaintained, deny vulnerabilities), and bans (deny duplicate versions of key crates). Add deny.toml config file. Artifact: .github/workflows/ci.yml step, deny.toml.

Acceptance: CI fails on any crate with a known CVE; CI fails on GPL-licensed dependencies; deny.toml is committed
